summary: The change follows the repo's own constitution and engineering rules closely (clean canonical render across all five harnesses, passing link-integrity and state/CLI contract checks, declared and justified test exemptions), with only a stale pair of step-number cross-references in data-model.md left over from the SKILL.md renumbering.

findings.summary: data-model.md cites stale step numbers for Worktree and impeccable resolution that no longer match the renumbered core/skills/factory/SKILL.md.
findings.evidence: Line 30: "...move into the worktree at step 3, unchanged from today's grilling (FR-004)" and line 63: "`impeccable` | step 6, only on a UI diff | ...". core/skills/factory/SKILL.md's final headings are `## 2. Brainstorm`, `## 3. Grill`, `## 4. Worktree`, `## 6. Implement`, `## 7. Review` (impeccable resolution happens in step 7, item 2). So "step 3" should be step 4, and "step 6" should be step 7 (ENG-7: comments/documentation must state current behaviour accurately and be updated when behaviour changes).
findings.fix: Update data-model.md's two step references to step 4 (Worktree) and step 7 (impeccable/Review) to match core/skills/factory/SKILL.md's final numbering.
